facts.title: Honey Whole Wheat Pumpkin Bread
ingredients: ⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil
½ teaspoon cinnamon, plus more to swirl on top
1 ¾ cups whole wheat pastry flour or regular whole wheat flour
Optional- ⅓ to ½ cup rinsed millet
Optional- turbinado (raw) sugar for sprinkling on top
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
